race.description: Carlton Draught Murray Bridge Gold Cup Prelude Hcp (Bm74)
race.comment: FAST TEMPO (5) made it three wins from his last four outings when he swept by his BM74 rivals over 1550m at the Parks track last start. Getting up in the weights but it is well-earned. Loves the sting out so be cautious if a good track is posted come race day. GEFFINA (6) quickened nicely under 59kgs to record an impressive first-up win over 1400m at Sandown last time out. Second-up stats not as impressive but that Melbourne form should hold its own here. FREEDOM FLAME (11) improved significantly last start at the second run of the campaign, chiming in late to be beaten half a length over 1514m at Morphettville. Very fit now and drops a couple of kilos which brings her right under notice. Market watch on the consistent MALDINI (7) first-up from an eight-week break.
